getSelection.label: Shown board
getSelection.hint: Whose archived columns are listed. Bind a tab strip and the two move together.

getBoard.label: Board
getBoard.hint: The board whose archived columns are listed.

getGroupBy.label: Group by
getGroupBy.hint: Write folder to split by the folder a note sits in, or the name of a property to split by its value.

getShownAtFirst.label: Bars shown at first
getShownAtFirst.hint: How many of the biggest groups get a bar before anything is pressed.

getStep.label: Bars added by a press
getStep.hint: How many more bars each press of Show more draws.

getShowMoreButton.label: Get show more button
getShowMoreButton.hint: Whether a press may draw past the first bars. Without it the rest are summed into one line.

getRecords.label: Records
getRecords.hint: The notes the chart reads, one point each.

getAcross.label: Across
getAcross.hint: The property each point stands at, such as a date or a name. Left empty, the note's own name. Dates are put in order.

getSeries.label: Series
getSeries.hint: The number properties drawn, in the order they are listed. Left empty, every property holding a number.

getKind.label: Drawn as
getKind.hint: A glance is the latest value of the first series with its sparkline under it.

getLines.label: Lines shown at first, and added by each press

getMaxKilobytes.label: Largest file that may be shown, in KB

getTabs.label: Tabs
getTabs.hint: Every tab is a record. A folder makes each a note; a typed list lives in this tile.

getLabel.label: Label field
getLabel.hint: Which field is written on a tab. Without it a note shows its own name.

getValue.label: Value field
getValue.hint: What a tab hands down, and what files a note under it. Without it the label stands in.

getSelection.label: Selected tab
getSelection.hint: Which tab is picked, as a box. Bind another widget and the two move together.

getItems.label: Items
getItems.hint: The records the feed draws, one after another, newest first when the source is sorted that way.

getPageSize.label: Items per load
getPageSize.hint: How many more are drawn each time the end of the feed comes into view.

getBoard.label: Board
getBoard.hint: Which board's tasks are offered. Bind the board tabs and only the tasks of the board on screen are counted.

getGroups.label: Filter by
getGroups.hint: The properties offered. Empty offers what the board names or the tasks carry.

getOpenGroup.label: Open by default
getOpenGroup.hint: Whose choices unfold on opening. Name none and it opens folded.

getProperties.label: Board properties
getProperties.hint: The properties this board names. Empty offers what the tasks carry.

getChosen.label: Chosen filters
getChosen.hint: What is ticked, as a box. Point a widget's Where at it and this narrows it.

getPick.label: Which habit
getPick.hint: One habit only. Nothing picked draws all of them.

getEntries.label: Lines
getEntries.hint: One line per point. Each carries its own icon and colour, and reads as markdown.

text.label: Text
text.hint: The line itself, as markdown: **bold**, `code`, a [[link]] and the rest all draw.

icon.label: Icon
icon.hint: The icon inside the disc, under the name the icon picker gives it — tick, close, alarm-clock. A name nothing answers to draws a dot.

tone.label: Colour
tone.hint: The colour behind the icon: neutral, accent, success, warning, error, info, note, standout or highlight. Any other word draws neutral.

rows.text: **A list — yes.** More columns visible, more rows in view.
**Prose — no.** Past ~75 characters the eye loses the next line.

getNumbered.label: Number the lines
getNumbered.hint: Off, every line shows its own icon. On, the discs count the lines instead — 1, 2, 3 — and keep their colours.

getSolid.label: Fill the discs
getSolid.hint: Off, a disc wears a pale wash of its colour. On, it is filled with the colour itself and the icon or number turns white.

getChosen.label: Chosen filters
getChosen.hint: Narrows the cards to what a filter panel has chosen.

getSelection.label: Shown board
getSelection.hint: Which board this draws. Bind a tab strip and the two move together.

getBoard.label: Board
getBoard.hint: The board this draws: its columns, their order and which of them are archived.

getOpened.label: Opened task
getOpened.hint: Which card is open, as a box. The board draws it full size itself.

getRows.label: Get rows
getRows.hint: The records this list draws, one apiece. Whatever a row holds is handed to the widget in the slot whole.

getHandedAs.label: Get handed as
getHandedAs.hint: The name of the prop the row arrives under. @default/task-card takes getTask, @flow/commit-row takes getCommit. A row widget that writes takes the same name with update in place of get.

getSelection.label: Selected row
getSelection.hint: Which row is picked. A detail tile reading the same collection follows it.

getFilter.label: Get filter
getFilter.hint: Only rows whose filtered field holds these words are listed. Bind a search field and the two move together.

getFilterField.label: Filtered field
getFilterField.hint: The field the filter is matched in.

getPageSize.label: Rows per page
getPageSize.hint: How many rows are read at first, and how many more each press of Show more reads.

getHeading.label: Get heading
getHeading.hint: A line above the rows. Left empty, none is drawn.

getPick.label: Which log
getPick.hint: The log this number is about.

getPeriod.label: Days the rate looks back over

getRecords.label: Records
getRecords.hint: One note per reading. Each carries a date and an amount.

getPeriods.label: Periods
getPeriods.hint: Every window the card can read over.

getDays.label: Days
getDays.hint: A folder of habit notes, or a folder of day notes for a single habit.

getPick.label: Which habit
getPick.hint: The habit this grid writes into. Bind it to a habit list and the month follows what the list picks.

getSource.label: Source
getSource.hint: The markdown to draw, typed here or bound to a note. # titles the page, ## a region, ### a group; plain lines are paragraphs. Links and embeds work as in a note.

getCollapsible.label: Collapse long text
getCollapsible.hint: Off, all of it is drawn. On, long text is cut to the collapsed height with Show more under it.

getCollapsedHeight.label: Collapsed height, in pixels
getCollapsedHeight.hint: How much of long text shows before Show more is pressed.

getStep.label: Show more step, in pixels
getStep.hint: How much each press of Show more opens. 0 opens all of it at once.

getRecords.label: Get records
getRecords.hint: The notes whose properties are counted.

getShownAtFirst.label: Properties shown at first
getShownAtFirst.hint: How many of the most used properties get a row before anything is pressed.

getStep.label: Properties added by a press
getStep.hint: How many more rows each press of Show more draws.

getShowMoreButton.label: Get show more button
getShowMoreButton.hint: Whether a press may draw past the first rows. Without it the rest are named as a count.

getValue.label: Query
getValue.hint: What is typed. Bind another widget to it and it filters as you type.

getHeading.label: Get heading
getHeading.hint: What this part of the screen is.

getBadgeTone.label: What the badge says it is
getBadgeTone.hint: The colour a badge wears is its meaning: a count is neutral, a problem is an error.

getBadge.label: Get badge
getBadge.hint: A count or a state, beside the heading. It says something about the body, never a filter.

getFilling.label: What fills it
getFilling.hint: Placed: you put each widget in yourself. Per row: one widget is drawn again for every row of the data.

options.label: One widget per row of data

getArrangement.label: How they stand
getArrangement.hint: A column reads down with nothing under it. A row and a grid give each widget its own plate. Rows stand in one plate with a line between them.

options.label: Across the row, a plate each
A grid that wraps, a plate each

getMinWidthPx.label: Narrowest a cell may be
getMinWidthPx.hint: The grid fits as many across as this allows, then wraps.

getItems.label: Rows to draw
getItems.hint: Bind the folder whose notes this section draws. The widget in the slot draws one of them at a time.

getPageSize.label: Rows drawn
getPageSize.hint: How many rows are drawn before the rest are asked for.

getOptions.label: Options
getOptions.hint: Every choice is a record. Bind a view box and it offers the views it holds.

getSelection.label: Shown choice
getSelection.hint: Which choice is shown. Bind the view box's own selection and the two move together.

getTitle.label: Habit name
getTitle.hint: What is written beside the emoji. Type one here, or take it from another widget's value.

getEmoji.label: Get emoji
getEmoji.hint: A Fluent emoji by name, such as smiling-face-with-halo. A name nobody drew leaves the row bare.

getRecords.label: Records
getRecords.hint: The notes the table draws, one row each. A value reading emoji:<name> or icon:<name> is drawn as that emoji or icon, with any words after it beside it.

getColumns.label: Columns
getColumns.hint: Which properties get a column, in the order they are listed. Left empty, every property the records carry gets one.

getRowTitle.label: Row title property
getRowTitle.hint: The property drawn in the bare first column that names each row. Left empty, the table has no such column.

getYesNo.label: Yes and no
getYesNo.hint: Whether a true or false value is drawn as Yes or No.

getRowsAtFirst.label: Rows shown at first
getRowsAtFirst.hint: How many records get a row before Show more is pressed. Each press draws that many again.

getFadeEdges.label: Fade the scrolling edges
getFadeEdges.hint: Whether an edge the table carries on past dissolves, so there is something to say it scrolls.

getTask.label: Task
getTask.hint: The task this card draws. Held in a board it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

getTitle.label: Get title
getTitle.hint: The one line naming the task, the way a person says it: Building Habit streak.

getSteps.label: Get steps
getSteps.hint: Every step in order. A status is pending, active, done or failed; the hint is the one line under an active step.

getIsOpen.label: Get is open
getIsOpen.hint: Whether the steps are shown. Pressing the line flips it.

getStartedAt.label: Get started at
getStartedAt.hint: When the task started, in milliseconds since 1970. Zero draws no clock.

getEndedAt.label: Get ended at
getEndedAt.hint: When the task ended, in milliseconds since 1970. Zero while it runs, so the clock keeps counting.

getText.label: Get text
getText.hint: The line itself. Left empty, the widget draws nothing at all.

getTone.label: Get tone
getTone.hint: It decides the weight and the ink, never the plate.

getHeading.label: Heading level
getHeading.hint: Zero draws a plain line. One, two or three draw the line as a heading of that level.

getLines.label: Get lines
getLines.hint: How many lines the text may take before it is cut. Zero lets it run as long as it is.

getCards.label: Cards
getCards.hint: The things being ranked. A folder of notes, or a list typed into the tile.

getTiers.label: Rows
getTiers.hint: The rows, top to bottom. Each carries its own colour, and its name is what a card points at.

getCardSize.label: Card size
getCardSize.hint: How wide one card is, in pixels. Between 32 and 160; the rows reflow around it.

getIsOpen.label: Open
getIsOpen.hint: Whether the box this opens is open. A box names it as its trigger, and reads it.

getIcon.label: Icon
getIcon.hint: The icon drawn on the button, picked off the grid: the kit's own glyphs and all of Lucide.

getLabel.label: Label
getLabel.hint: What a screen reader says the button does.

getOptions.label: Options
getOptions.hint: Every section is a record. Bind a view box and it offers the views it holds.

getSelection.label: Open section
getSelection.hint: Which section is open. Bind the view box's own selection and the two move together.

getSelection.label: Shown view
getSelection.hint: Which held widget is drawn. Bind a switcher and the two move together.

getOptions.label: Options
getOptions.hint: Every option is a record. Bind a view group and it offers the views it holds.

getSelection.label: Picked option
getSelection.hint: Which option is picked. Bind the view group's own box and the two move together.

getCommit.label: Commit
getCommit.hint: The commit this row draws. Held in a tree it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

value.subject: feat(catalogue): let the agent see the whole catalogue instead of only what the vault happens to hold

getFiles.label: Files
getFiles.hint: One record per file the change touched. Bind a commit list beside this one and the two move together.

getCommit.label: Commit
getCommit.hint: Only the files of this commit are listed. Bind a commit list beside this one and the two move together; left unset, every file is listed.

getSelection.label: Selected file
getSelection.hint: Which file is picked. A diff standing beside this list binds to it and follows every press.

getHeading.label: Heading
getHeading.hint: The words standing before the count. Left empty, only the count is drawn.

getShownFiles.label: Files shown
getShownFiles.hint: How many rows are read at once, and how many more each press adds.

getFile.label: File
getFile.hint: The file this row draws. Held in a list it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

getFlight.label: Flight
getFlight.hint: The work this row draws. Held in a list it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

getCommits.label: Commits
getCommits.hint: The commit records written for this branch, newest first. Only the sha and its parents are drawn.

getBranch.label: Branch
getBranch.hint: The name of the branch these commits are on. Left empty, no name is drawn.

getShownCommits.label: Commits shown
getShownCommits.hint: How many of the newest commits the graph spans.

getFlights.label: Flights
getFlights.hint: One record per piece of work in flight. The newest start is drawn first.

getSelection.label: Selected flight
getSelection.hint: Which row is picked. A detail tile that picks from the same list follows it.

getPageSize.label: Rows per page
getPageSize.hint: How many rows are read at once, and how many more each press adds.

getEntry.label: Entry
getEntry.hint: The line this draws. Inside a log it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

getTitle.label: Title
getTitle.hint: The one line a person reads first. Left empty, the notice says it has nothing to report.

getBody.label: Body
getBody.hint: The sentence under the title, for what the title could not hold.

getIcon.label: Icon
getIcon.hint: The glyph beside the text, picked off the grid. Left empty, no icon is drawn.

getTone.label: Tone
getTone.hint: Neutral draws no background of its own.

getAction.label: Action
getAction.hint: What the button says. Left empty, the notice carries no button.

getIsPressed.label: Pressed
getIsPressed.hint: Whether the action has been pressed. A box names it as its trigger, or another tile reads it by ref.

getQuestions.label: Questions
getQuestions.hint: One record per question asked, each carrying the options offered, the answer chosen and the reason for it.

question.label: Question
question.hint: The question that was asked, in full.

options.label: Options
options.hint: Every option that was offered, as a list or separated by commas.

answer.label: Answer
answer.hint: The option that was chosen. An answer naming none of them is drawn beside them, not dropped.

rows.question: Where does the loading threshold live?
rows.reason: One number a person can find and change, instead of three settings nobody tunes.

rows.question: How many rows does a list hand over when nothing asked for a number?
rows.reason: Enough to fill a screen twice, few enough that a vault of a thousand notes cannot take the frame with it.

getProject.label: Project
getProject.hint: The project this card draws. Held in a grid it is handed down; standing alone it is the one bound here.

getProjects.label: Projects
getProjects.hint: One note per project. Bind the folder they live in.

getSelection.label: Selected project
getSelection.hint: The project the pressed card names. Bind a task list or a docs tree to it and they follow the press.

getPageSize.label: Projects per load
getPageSize.hint: How many cards are drawn before the rest are asked for.

getAsked.label: Question
getAsked.hint: The question, the options it offered, the answer that was chosen and the reason for it. Standing in a record it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

value.question: Where does the loading threshold live?
value.reason: One number a person can find and change, instead of three settings nobody tunes.

getBody.label: Report
getBody.hint: The prose of the report, typed here or bound to a note. Headings, lists and links work as they do in a note.

getFigures.label: Figures
getFigures.hint: One record per figure, each drawn by the widget in the figure slot.

getTestPlan.label: Test plan
getTestPlan.hint: One record per step: what to press, and what should happen when it is pressed.

getFixes.label: What was fixed
getFixes.hint: One record per fix, with the file it was made in.

getMeasure.label: Reading width, in characters
getMeasure.hint: How wide the prose is allowed to run. A figure ignores it and takes the whole tile.

getStepsPerPage.label: Test steps per page
getStepsPerPage.hint: How many steps of the test plan are drawn at once.

getSource.label: Figure
getSource.hint: The figure to draw: a caption, and either the name of an image this vault holds or a drawing written as markdown.

getLines.label: Lines
getLines.hint: The log this draws, newest first. Each row is one line: when it was written, what it says, how it went.

getLinesKept.label: Lines kept
getLinesKept.hint: How many of the newest lines are held on screen. Older ones stay in the source and are counted, not drawn.

getIsFollowing.label: Follow the newest line
getIsFollowing.hint: Whether the view sticks to the end. It lets go when the reader scrolls away and takes hold again on a press.

getAlbum.label: Album
getAlbum.hint: The album this cover draws. Held in a shelf it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

getBeside.label: Art beside the text
getBeside.hint: On, the art stands on the leading edge with the title and artist beside it rather than beneath.

getAlbums.label: Albums
getAlbums.hint: The records the shelf draws, one cell each.

getPageSize.label: Albums per load
getPageSize.hint: How many more are drawn each time the end of the shelf comes into view.

getTracks.label: Tracks
getTracks.hint: The queue. One note per track, in the order the bound folder is sorted.

getPlaying.label: Playing
getPlaying.hint: Which track is loaded. Bind a queue beside it and the two move together.

getIsPlaying.label: Playing state
getIsPlaying.hint: Whether the transport stands at play or at pause.

getPosition.label: Position
getPosition.hint: How far into the track the transport stands, in seconds.

getVolume.label: Volume
getVolume.hint: The level the transport is set to, from nothing to full.

getIsShuffled.label: Shuffle
getIsShuffled.hint: Whether the next track is the one after this or one drawn at random.

getRepeat.label: Repeat
getRepeat.hint: What the end of the queue does.

getTracks.label: Tracks
getTracks.hint: The notes this list draws, one row each. Every field may be missing — a folder of loose recordings is the normal case.

getSelection.label: Selected track
getSelection.hint: Which track is picked. A player bound to this plays whatever the list picks.

getPlaying.label: Playing track
getPlaying.hint: Which track is playing now. A player writes it; the row it names wears an equaliser and a heavier title.

getFilter.label: Filter
getFilter.hint: Only tracks whose title holds these words are listed. Bind a search field and the two move together.

getPageSize.label: Tracks per page
getPageSize.hint: How many rows are read at first, and how many more each press of Show more reads.

getTrack.label: Track
getTrack.hint: The track this row draws. Held in a list it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

getPosition.label: Place in the list
getPosition.hint: The number drawn where the equaliser stands while the track is playing.

getIsPlaying.label: Playing
getIsPlaying.hint: Whether this is the track playing now. The row answers with an equaliser and a heavier title.
